title: Coherent Hom transports with faithful reflexive transitions form an additive directed system
statement:
Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder and let $S=(C_i,T_{ij},a_{ijk})$ be a stage system as defined in [def-sf-directed-common-stage-data]; in particular its natural associators $a_{ijk}:T_{jk}T_{ij}\cong T_{ik}$ satisfy the displayed cocycle, including repeated indices. Suppose each $C_i$ is preadditive [def-weil-preadditive-category], each $T_{ij}$ is additive (its maps on Hom groups preserve sums), and each reflexive functor $T_{ii}$ is faithful, meaning that its map on every Hom set is injective. No literal equality $T_{ii}=\mathrm{id}$ or specified unitor is assumed. For $A=(i,x)$ and $B=(j,y)$ let $J_{A,B}=\{m\in I:i,j\le m\}$, with its induced preorder, and put $G_m=\operatorname{Hom}_{C_m}(T_{im}x,T_{jm}y)$. Define
$$t_{mn}(u)=a_{jmn,y}\circ T_{mn}(u)\circ a_{imn,x}^{-1}\quad(m\le n).$$
Then every $t_{mn}$ is an additive homomorphism, $t_{mm}(u)=u$, and $t_{np}(t_{mn}(u))=t_{mp}(u)$ for $m\le n\le p$. Thus these maps form a directed system of abelian groups [def-weil-directed-colimit-abelian-groups]. These assertions hold for arbitrary independent universes of the index, objects and morphisms.

proof.text: For a common stage m, StageSystem.tr_tr with both inequalities reflexive gives S.tr refl (S.tr refl f) = S.tr refl f. Apply StageSystem.tr_injective to this equality to get (S.T refl).map (S.tr refl f) = (S.T refl).map f. Faithfulness of S.T refl makes its map injective, yielding S.tr refl f = f. No unitor or normalization is used.

proof.text: An upper bound of A.stage and B.stage supplies a point of the common-stage subtype. Given two points m,n of the subtype, an upper bound p in I is again a common stage, using the inequalities through m, and bounds m and n in the induced preorder. Bundle the additive maps from step 1 and their pointwise canonical-transport equation (reflexivity). The identity from step 3 and composition from step 2 fill the two fields of Mathlib DirectedSystem, the directed-system notion used in [def-weil-directed-colimit-abelian-groups].

lean.statement: theorem faithful_hom_transport {I : Type w} [Preorder I] [IsDirectedOrder I] [Nonempty I] {C : I → Type u} [∀ i : I, Category.{v} (C i)] (S : StageSystem C) [∀ i : I, Preadditive (C i)] [∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), (S.T h).Additive] [∀ i : I, (S.T (le_refl i)).Faithful] (A B : S.PairCategory) : Nonempty {m : I // A.stage ≤ m ∧ B.stage ≤ m} ∧ IsDirectedOrder {m : I // A.stage ≤ m ∧ B.stage ≤ m} ∧ ∃ t : ∀ (m n : {m : I // A.stage ≤ m ∧ B.stage ≤ m}), m ≤ n → (A.toStage m.2.1 ⟶ B.toStage m.2.2) →+ (A.toStage n.2.1 ⟶ B.toStage n.2.2), (∀ (m n : {m : I // A.stage ≤ m ∧ B.stage ≤ m}) (h : m ≤ n) (f : A.toStage m.2.1 ⟶ B.toStage m.2.2), t m n h f = S.tr h f) ∧ DirectedSystem (fun m : {m : I // A.stage ≤ m ∧ B.stage ≤ m} ↦ A.toStage m.2.1 ⟶ B.toStage m.2.2) (fun {m n} h ↦ t m n h)
